# Donald Trump's job approval falls to 33%

August 11, 2026

Only one-third (33%) of Americans strongly or somewhat approve of how Donald Trump is handling his job as president, according to the latest Economist / YouGov Poll. That's the smallest share to ever approve of Trump's job handling in any Economist / YouGov Poll across both of Trump's terms. Meanwhile 62% disapprove of Trump, the most to ever do so. [...] Almost all Democrats disapprove of Trump's job performance: 4% approve and 95% disapprove, for a net approval of -91. This near-unanimous disapproval from Democrats has been the case for most of Trump's second term.
